parsed.rationale: Both `HLSRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 38 in `HLSPlayerMessages.swift`) and `PlayerRateDidChangeMessage.makeNotification` (line 42 in `RadioPlayerMessages.swift`) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package. Because the implementations are identical and neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift fix is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `RateDidChangeMessage`) with a default implementation of `makeNotification` in a protocol extension, allowing both concrete message types to drop their individual implementations entirely.
